integrity: The homotopy claim is proved by an explicit finite acyclic discrete-Morse matching on the entire nonempty face poset. Independent boundary-rank calculations over \(\mathbb F_2\) are used only as a cross-check, not as a substitute for the homotopy proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the single natural boundary instance \(M_2(K_{3,4})\), not the full parameter range \(r<\min(m,n)\).
Earlier rational-homology formulas for generalized chessboard complexes may recover homology at this parameter, but they do not by themselves imply the homotopy-sphere statement.
The originality assessment is limited to the inspected primary literature, indexed searches, and available prior ledger.
title: The two-matching complex of \(K_{3,4}\) is a 5-sphere
